subjects.label: MFE Root Config
subjects.description: HTML and static entry; Single-SPA bootstrap with @fm/base as its sole application.

subjects.label: MFE Base
subjects.description: Portal-wide UI services and SystemJS loading. Single-UI-Authorization injection has documented request exceptions.

subjects.label: RATAN Container
subjects.description: Shared application components and services. props.module selects application routes and tile loaders.

subjects.label: Cashflow Blotter

subjects.label: Nginx
subjects.description: User-reported first ingress endpoint. This template copy includes gateway routes and direct proxy exceptions.

subjects.label: Single UI BFF
subjects.description: User-reported sole backend for this portal scope: login, logout, sessions, administration, and analytics. Health-management mapping remains unconfirmed.

subjects.label: Single UI SDK starter
subjects.description: Java library for application backend token validation. It is not a deployed HTTP service. Universal downstream adoption remains unverified.

subjects.label: RATAN Auth Server
subjects.description: User-reported RATAN service authentication and external API authorization. Local source supports OUD, FMAA, and EMS2 integrations.

subjects.label: API Gateway
subjects.description: User-reported second ingress endpoint. Gateway source is unavailable and excluded from implementation analysis.

subjects.label: Application backend services
subjects.description: User reports SDK adoption across application backend services. Exact consumers are outside the local inventory.

subjects.label: OUD
subjects.description: User-reported delegated authentication. Local Auth source includes LDAP authentication.

subjects.label: Entra SPN
subjects.description: User reports Auth delegation. This Auth copy has no matching local implementation; BFF has a separate Entra integration.

subjects.label: FMAA
subjects.description: User-reported delegated authentication. Local Auth source includes FMAA introspection.

subjects.label: EMS2
subjects.description: User-reported delegated authorization. Local Auth and SDK source include EMS2 calls.

subjects.label: EMS3
subjects.description: User reports Auth delegation. This Auth copy has no matching local implementation; BFF has a separate EMS3 integration.

relationships.description: Single-SPA registers the shell; SystemJS loads its entry module.
Shell loads the configured container and forwards module, tile, parameters, panelId, and tabId.
Container routing selects the tile loader; SystemJS imports the tile and forwards props.
Container imports shared shell routing, services, and UI context.
Tile imports shared shell routing, services, and UI context.
Tile imports shared application components from the container library.
Shell calls portal BFF APIs. This logical contract does not bypass the reported ingress and gateway transport.
User reports one public domain with DNS forwarding to Nginx. Effective DNS and deployment remain unverified.
User reports API Gateway as the second endpoint. Templates also contain direct proxy exceptions.
User reports forwarding to the portal BFF. Gateway route configuration is unavailable and excluded.
User reports SDK adoption for token validation across application services. Exact consumer evidence is unavailable.
User reports RATAN service authentication and external caller authorization through Auth. Consumers remain unspecified.
User reports OUD delegation. LDAP paths exist in local source.
User reports Entra SPN delegation. Local Auth implementation remains unconfirmed.
User reports FMAA delegation. Introspection paths exist in local source.
User reports EMS2 delegation. EMS2 request paths exist in local source.
User reports EMS3 delegation. Local Auth implementation remains unconfirmed.

notes.description: This view contains user-reported architecture and source-review qualifications. It does not promote runtime joins or select deployments.
Single-SPA application registration differs from component loading. Shell, container, and tile use successive props and routing boundaries.
Single JavaScript entry bundles can emit lazy chunks. The clarification does not establish one physical output file.
Source uses Single-UI-Authorization. Authentication, analytics, and SSE requests include exceptions. Relogin uses Single-UI-Refresh.
DNS, rendered Ansible values, and gateway route configuration are unavailable. Gateway analysis remains out of scope.
Local Auth source does not establish Entra SPN or EMS3 integrations. BFF has separate Entra and EMS3 code paths.
SDK repository identity is single-ui-auth-sdk. Its graph identity follows directory name repo:single-ui-sdk-starter. It is a library.
Admin endpoints exist. The phrase admin module health management has no confirmed dedicated endpoint mapping.
